_doc: Math domain: MathPilot 112-task bank, five-stage solve pipeline, symbolic answer matching (no LLM judge). Paper-relevant notes: (1) cost C is proxied by wall-clock seconds per trial because the result jsonl carries elapsed_sec but NOT token counts -- set cost_kind=elapsed_sec in the adapter; beta1 is therefore 'extra seconds per additional solved task', not 'extra tokens'. (2) delta is null on purpose: the noise band has never been measured for this harness, run `rrsi.py --domain math calibrate` first. (3) T=2 and k=1 on purpose: this instance exists to inspect proposal quality in rounds 0-1, not to claim a score gain.
